AVAIL:Description: Chris Lant provides an overview tour of the NASA Glenn Research Center’s Space Experiments Laboratory, which is part of the Zero Gravity Facility. The Space Experiments Laboratory contains a breadboard version of the Light Microscopy Module (LMM) that is on the International Space Station (ISS) being conducted in cooperation with NASA Glenn Research Center.
